chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Abdullah ibn al-Hasan al-Mu'addab narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Ali al-Isfahani, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Ibrahim ibn Musa, the son of the sister of al-Waqidi, a shaykh of the Ansar, narrated to us. He said: Abu Qutada al-Harrani narrated to us from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi al-'Ala' al-Hadrami, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu al-Hamra'. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

On the night of the Night Journey, I saw written on a pillar of the pillars of the Throne: 'I am Allah. There is no god but Me. I created the Paradise of Eden with My two hands. Muhammad is My elite one from My creation. I have aided him with Ali, and I have supported him with Ali.'

key_terms.الإسراء: al-Isra' (the Night Journey) - the Prophet's miraculous journey from Mecca to Jerusalem
key_terms.جنة عدن: Jannat 'Adn (Paradise of Eden) - the Garden created by Allah's own hands
key_terms.صفوتي: safwati (My elite/chosen one) - indicating Muhammad's special election by God

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet see written on the Throne during the Night Journey?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) recounts what he saw inscribed on the Throne during the Night Journey (Isra'): a divine declaration affirming tawhid, the creation of Paradise, and the special election of Muhammad with Ali as his divinely appointed supporter. This hadith from Abu al-Hamra', a companion, was shared in the 38th assembly of al-Saduq's Amali.
